name: Storyset
summary: Free customizable and animated vector illustrations in five styles (Rafiki, Bro, Amico, Pana, Cuate).
description: Library of thousands of illustrated concepts grouped by topic (business, education, medical, technology, people, multi-purpose) and by style. An online editor recolours illustrations, swaps backgrounds, toggles layers and applies entrance or looping animations. Illustrations download free for personal and commercial use with attribution, and a Figma plugin adds them to Figma files.
